description:
## What

Seven of the twelve 1.0-scope crates currently have no `CHANGELOG.md` at all. PKIX-wlsr.7 implicitly assumes each crate has a CHANGELOG with an `[Unreleased]` section to roll up; that assumption fails for these seven crates. They need CHANGELOGs authored from scratch first.

The workspace-level `/home/mark/PROJECT/PKIX/CHANGELOG.md` (1726 lines) carries unified per-crate release notes already. The work is to extract each crate's history from the workspace CHANGELOG into its own per-crate `CHANGELOG.md`, formatted to match the convention used by the existing five (pkix-chain, pkix-identity, pkix-profiles-cabf, pkix-lint-cabf, pkix-aia).

## Affected crates

- `pkix-path` (foundation crate; substantial history; current 0.3.0)
- `pkix-revocation` (current 0.3.2)
- `pkix-path-builder` (current 0.3.1)
- `pkix-truststore` (current 0.0.0)
- `pkix-profiles` (current 0.3.0)
- `pkix-lint` (current 0.9.0)
- `pkix-revocation-http` (current 0.0.0)

## Acceptance

- [ ] Each of the seven crates has a `CHANGELOG.md` matching the Keep a Changelog convention used by the existing five
- [ ] Each CHANGELOG covers the crate's history accurately (cross-referenced against the workspace CHANGELOG + git log + bead memories)
- [ ] An `[Unreleased]` section captures any not-yet-released-from-this-crate content (ready for .7.2 to roll up into 1.0.0)
- [ ] No content is fabricated — anything that cannot be traced to a real event in git log / bead history / workspace CHANGELOG is omitted

## Cross-references

- PKIX-wlsr.7 (parent)
- /home/mark/PROJECT/PKIX/CHANGELOG.md (workspace-level unified CHANGELOG — primary source for extraction)
- Per-crate convention reference: pkix-chain/CHANGELOG.md, pkix-identity/CHANGELOG.md, pkix-aia/CHANGELOG.md
title: Author missing CHANGELOG.md for 7 1.0-scope crates (pkix-path, pkix-revocation, pkix-path-builder, pkix-truststore, pkix-profiles, pkix-lint, pkix-revocation-http)
